title: Single-Strand Conformation Polymorphism (SSCP) for Diatraea Species Identification
author: Gloria Patricia Barrera1
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.invcde6
materials: Dissection and DNA extraction : Abdomens from insects were dissected and maintained in ethanol at 70 % v/v in sterile distilled water to DNA extractions. DNA of male insects were obtained of complete abdomen by using commercial kit (DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit, QIAGEN) and quantified by spectrophotometry (Nanodrop 1000, Thermo-Fisher). DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit, QIAGEN Contributed by users Catalog #Cat No./ID: 69504

2.COII amplification: In vitro amplifications of CO II fragments were carried out by the Polymerase Chain Reaction method (PCR) in standard conditions (final volume 25 µL) using Taq polymerase (PROMEGA), 50 ng of template and the primers previously described and used in Diatraea: A-298 (5’-ATTGGACATCAATGATATTGA-3’) and B-tLYS (5’ GTTTAAGAGACCAGTACTTG-3’) (Simon et al. 1994; Lange et al. 2004, Palacio et al. 2010). Thermal cycling was performed using the following conditions: 1 cycle at 95 °C for 3 min; 34 cycles at 95 °C for 10 s; 53 °C for 45 s, and 72 °C for 30 s; and one cycle at 72 °C for 5 min. Aliquots of amplification products were resolved in 1% w/v agarose gel electrophoresis and later stained with SYBR-Safe (Invitrogen). Amplicons were used for SSCP methodology. Taq polymerase Promega Catalog #M3001 SYBR Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #S33102

steps.title: Prepare and denature amplicons
steps.instruction: Prepare the PCR products for SSCP by mixing and denaturing them.

substeps.instruction: Mix 1 µL of PCR products (amplified using A-298/B-tLYS) with 9 µL of sample buffer (95% v/v Formamide, 20mM EDTA, 0.05% w/v bromophenol blue, and 0.05% w/v Xylene-cyanol in distilled water).
Denature the mixture at 95 °C for 5 min.
Immediately store the samples in an ice bath.

steps.title: Perform electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Separate the denatured samples using a non-denaturing polyacrylamide gel.

substeps.instruction: Load 1.5 µL of each sample into a 6% non-denaturing polyacrylamide gel (49 acrylamide: 1 bis-acrylamide).
Run electrophoresis for 4 hours at 600V using a BioRad Sequi-Gen GT Nucleic Acid Electrophoresis Cell (38 x 50 cm).

steps.title: Stain gels using silver nitrate method
steps.instruction: Stain the PAGE gels using an adapted silver nitrate method to visualize results.

substeps.instruction: Fix gels for 3 min in 10% v/v ethanol and 1% v/v acetic acid in distilled water.
Oxidize gels for 3 min in 1.5% v/v nitric acid in distilled water.
Stain gels for 20 min in 0.1% w/v silver nitrate and 0.045% v/v formaldehyde in distilled water.
Reveal for approximately 5 min in 3% w/v NaCO3 and 0.02% v/v formaldehyde in distilled water.
Stop the reaction with a 5% v/v acetic acid solution in distilled water.

steps.title: Document results
steps.instruction: Document the final results using digital photography.
